lines.sentence: The silence that takes over the String of Life is comforting, especially after the loudest night the bar maid has had in quite a long time. The front door opening was the only thing that drew her attention back up.
Apologies, but the taverna is closed right now. I just managed to get the too-drunk folk out my door.
Actually, I’m not here for a drink. I was wondering instead if you might have found any jewelry recently?
… Jewelry? This is an inn ma’am, I believe you might have the wrong establishment. If you’ve lost something, I can keep an eye out for it if I know what to look for?
It’s a pendant. It belongs to my love, I’d appreciate its return.
The bar maid took a second and doubled back toward the box that she kept it in.
You never used it? All of its power… Why? You know that he was wrong. You are strong enough to…

I haven’t found something I wanted enough yet. It also helps that one of the bards that comes by speaks rather passionately about many things, even his own suffering. He’s a bit of a light in the darkness huh?
Nothing, thank you for keeping it safe. I promise to take good care of it, and to return it to its rightful owner.
Then, the mysterious figure left as quick as they came, the power to control the universe in their hand…
The door squeaked closed, and the second it slid into place, the world went black.
No… it ceased to exist. Mountains, cities, forests, people, animals… Even gods. All gone in the blink of an eye.
